description: This file contains the implementation of the PlacementService class, which manages placement decisions for grain activations in Orleans. It includes methods for addressing messages, selecting compatible silos, and placing grains, along with internal worker classes and detailed logging.

classes.name: PlacementService
classes.description: Manages grain placement and message targeting within Orleans Silo, including cache handling, silo compatibility checks, and worker threads for placement requests.

classes.name: PlacementService.PlacementWorker
classes.description: Internal class responsible for asynchronously processing placement requests and message targeting in worker threads.

classes.name: PlacementService.PlacementWorker.GrainPlacementWorkItem
classes.description: Represents an ongoing placement work item with a list of messages and a task for the placement result.

methods.name: PlacementService.AddressMessage
methods.description: Addresses a message to a grain, using cache if available, or delegating to a worker thread.

methods.name: PlacementService.SetMessageTargetPlacement
methods.description: Sets the target silo address for a message.

methods.name: PlacementService.GetCompatibleSilos
methods.description: Returns a list of silos compatible with a given placement target, applying filtering strategies.

methods.name: PlacementService.AllActiveSilos
methods.description: Retrieves all active silos, defaulting to the local silo if none are reported.

methods.name: PlacementService.CachedAddressIsValid
methods.description: Checks whether a cached grain address remains valid for a message, considering cache invalidation updates.

methods.name: PlacementService.PlaceGrainAsync
methods.description: Places a grain asynchronously by selecting an appropriate silo based on the placement director.
